store.description: Papers, Please in the browser. Inspect documents at the border of Arstotzka — decide who gets in, catch forgers and smugglers, and keep your family alive on a meagre salary.
features: Full border-inspection gameplay with documents and rules
Spot discrepancies, stamp passports, search bodies
Runs in the browser — no download, no account
Reload and Open-in-Browser toolbar if the frame is blocked
